from.place: The existing section-normalized operation and coherence interfaces for the coefficient tower shriek calculus.

title: Section-normalized coefficient tower calculus interfaces
statement: For the actual positive coefficient quotients and the section-normalized tower operations of [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels], define the intrinsic scalar coordinates, ordinary evaluation coordinates, finite direct-image coordinates, finite compact-support normalization, composition operations and coherence, etale calculus, reduction calculus and their combined Calculus interface. These are exactly the existing definitions previously attached to [lem-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-calculus], relocated without changing their signatures or bodies. Scalar coordinates fix the restriction maps on sections and preserve the specified scalar adjunction unit; finite coordinates fix all sections. The composition and reduction fields refer to the specified geometric operations and canonical mates, rather than arbitrary isomorphisms.
